entities.summary:
Harmala ibn Kahil was an archer at the Umayyad side at the Battle of Karbala in 61 AH, playing a pivotal role in the tragic events that unfolded.

Born in an unknown location, Harmala ibn Kahil's life was marked by violence and bloodshed, as he participated in the infamous Battle of Karbala, where the Umayyad forces clashed with the followers of Husayn ibn Ali, the grandson of Muhammad. This pivotal event in Islamic history left an indelible mark on the world, shaping the trajectory of the Islamic world and the Middle East.

The consequences of Harmala ibn Kahar's actions can still be felt today, with the event remaining a powerful symbol of resistance against oppressive regimes. His legacy continues to inspire and provoke, serving as a reminder of the enduring power of faith and conviction in the face of adversity.

The Battle of Karbala remains one of the most infamous events in Islamic history, with the tragic fate of Husayn ibn Ali and his companions serving as a stark warning against the dangers of tyranny and oppression.
